WITH rotation_schedule AS (
    SELECT 
        s.artregistry AS artifact_id,
        s.artname AS artifact_name,
        s.mattype AS material_type,
        u.displaydurmonths AS current_display_duration,
        sens.displaysafetyduration AS display_limit,
        ((sens.displaysafetyduration - u.displaydurmonths) * (l.lightlux + 1) * (risk.conservepriorityscore + 1)) / 100 AS calculated_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN ((sens.displaysafetyduration - u.displaydurmonths) * (l.lightlux + 1) * (risk.conservepriorityscore + 1)) / 100 <= 50 THEN 'Immediate Rotation' 
            ELSE 'Monitor'
        END AS recommendation
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS s
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS u ON s.artregistry = u.artrefused
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS r ON s.artregistry = r.artref
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS risk ON s.artregistry = risk.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        lightandradiationreadings AS l ON l.envreadref = l.envreadref
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore AS e ON l.envreadref = e.envreadregistry
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments AS c ON e.envreadregistry = c.lightreadrefobserved
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS sens ON s.artregistry = sens.artref
    WHERE 
        u.displayrotatesched = 'Active'
)
SELECT * FROM rotation_schedule;

            ) / 30 + 1
        )) / 100 AS calculated_score,
        -- Determine recommendation based on ERPS
        CASE 
            WHEN ((
                (36 * (10 - sens.lightsensitivity) * (10 - sens.tempsensitivity) * (10 - sens.humiditysensitivity)) / 1000
                - u.displaydurmonths
            ) * (
                (l.lightlux * sens.lightsensitivity * l.visibleexplxh) / 1000 + 1
            ) * (
                (
                    (r.histsignrating + r.researchvalrating + r.cultscore)
                    * (10 - CASE s.conservestatus
                        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END)
                ) / 30 + 1
            )) / 100 <= 50 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
            ELSE 'Monitor'
        END AS recommendation
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS s
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS u ON s.artregistry = u.artrefused
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS r ON s.artregistry = r.artref
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS risk ON s.artregistry = risk.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        lightandradiationreadings AS l ON l.envreadref = l.envreadref
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore AS e ON l.envreadref = e.envreadregistry
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments AS c ON e.envreadregistry = c.lightreadrefobserved
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS sens ON s.artregistry = sens.artref
    WHERE 
        u.displayrotatesched = 'Active'
)
SELECT * FROM rotation_schedule;
